# PROMPTS.md — OPT Countdown: Final Project Pitch

## Status

**No generation prompts.** Nothing in this film was generated by an image, video or voice model beyond the local Kokoro text-to-speech (free, offline). All twelve pictures are drawn in Manim code in `scenes.py`, and the opener is the stock `BrutalistHesitantWriter` component.

## Authoring prompts (Claude Code, 2026-10-13)

The script, beat sheet and scenes were drafted by Claude Code in one session that I directed. See `../BUILD-PROMPT.md` for the prompts and `../SOURCES.md` for what Claude contributed.
